description: Manage Google Drive files and folders: search files, read file content and metadata, create files and folders, upload content, rename, move, trash, copy, permanently delete, and share.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

instructions: Find files with searchFiles before reading or modifying them; file IDs come from there. readFile returns content, getFile returns metadata. updateFile renames, moves and replaces content; shareFile manages permissions; deleteFile trashes by default.
name: gdrive
title: Google Drive

tools.description: Search or list files in Drive (files.list)

corpora.description: Collection to search: user, domain, drive or allDrives

fields.description: Which fields to return, e.g. files(id,name,mimeType)

includeItemsFromAllDrives.description: Include shared drive items in the results

pageToken.description: Token for the next page of results

q.description: Search query, e.g. name contains 'budget' and trashed=false

spaces.description: Spaces to query: drive or appDataFolder

supportsAllDrives.description: Whether the app supports shared drives

tools.name: searchFiles
tools.title: Search files

tools.name: readFile
tools.title: Read a file
tools.description: Read a file's content: downloads regular files, exports Google Docs, Sheets and Slides to the requested MIME type (files.export / files.get)

exportMimeType.description: MIME type to export Google-native files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) as; defaults to text/plain

tools.description: Get a file's metadata by ID (files.get)

fields.description: Which fields to return, e.g. id,name,mimeType,parents,webViewLink

supportsAllDrives.description: Whether the app supports shared drives

tools.name: getFile
tools.title: Get a file

tools.description: Create a file or folder, optionally with content (files.create)

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content; when present the file is uploaded (multipart)

contentMimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded content; defaults to mimeType, then application/octet-stream

mimeType.description: MIME type; use application/vnd.google-apps.folder to create a folder

tools.name: createFile
tools.title: Create a file

tools.description: Update a file: rename, move, trash or restore, replace content (files.update)

addParents.description: IDs of parent folders to add (moving)

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded replacement content; when present the content is replaced (multipart)

contentMimeType.description: MIME type of the replacement content; defaults to application/octet-stream

name.description: A new name for the file

removeParents.description: IDs of parent folders to remove (moving)

trashed.description: true to trash the file, false to restore it

tools.name: updateFile
tools.title: Update a file

parents.description: IDs of the parent folders for the copy

tools.description: Permanently delete a file; cannot be undone (files.delete)
tools.name: deleteFile
tools.title: Delete a file

tools.description: Share a file: grant a permission to a user, group, domain or anyone (permissions.create)

emailAddress.description: Email address for user or group permissions

emailMessage.description: Custom message for the notification email

sendNotificationEmail.description: Whether to send a notification email

tools.name: shareFile
tools.title: Share a file
